skills.heading: What I work with
skills.subheading: Tools and technologies I use to design, build and ship software systems.

bullets: Developed and maintained Java 11/Spring Boot microservices for telecom platforms serving more than 5 million subscribers, with a focus on reliability and performance.
Reduced API response times from ~800ms to ~150ms by introducing Redis caching and optimising JPA queries — a 5× latency improvement.
Built REST API integrations with 6+ external systems, improving reliability and reducing integration failure points by 30%.
Implemented OAuth2/JWT authentication, role-based access control and audit logging for a multi-tenant environment.
Improved Docker-based deployments and CI/CD workflows using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, reducing release-cycle time by ~25%.
Developed real-time analytics dashboards, supported production incidents and mentored two junior engineers across backend and frontend development.
Shipped independent backend features within three months of joining; contributed to decomposition of a legacy monolithic application into independently deployable Spring Boot microservices.
Optimised 15+ complex SQL queries and stored procedures in PostgreSQL, reducing average query execution time by up to 40%.
Wrote unit and integration tests using JUnit 5, improving test coverage for critical payment-processing modules.
Containerised services with Docker and contributed to Jenkins deployment workflows as part of the microservices migration initiative.
Developed and maintained enterprise logistics and cargo revenue accounting modules in Java and Spring Boot, handling high-volume financial transactions for aviation clients.
Reduced production issue resolution time by ~25% through systematic log analysis using Linux tools and SQL profiling — identifying root causes faster across Java-based banking and IT systems.
Contributed to Jenkins CI/CD pipeline improvements, reducing manual deployment steps and friction for the team.
Built REST API endpoints and backend modules; shipped features independently and supported bug fixes with JUnit unit tests.
Built REST API endpoints and backend modules under mentorship in a Java and Spring Boot enterprise environment.
Contributed to bug fixes and unit testing with JUnit across Java-based applications for banking and IT clients.
Analysed production issues and supported debugging of enterprise Java applications, developing systematic log reading and SQL profiling skills.
